integrity.claim_scope: One proved exact optimum with uniqueness, positivity, and a same-price corollary
integrity.computational_checks: verify.py records 1,078 exact/numerical assertion groups; finite checks are supplemental
integrity.historical_research_limit: Originality assessed against accessible results; not a proof of absence of prior literature.

scientific_limitations: The exact optimizer is established only for four-cycles sharing one hub, two within-cycle edge price classes, positive linear prices, and unrestricted nonnegative conductance choices.
Implicit unique positive quartic roots are permitted, and the theorem does not classify arbitrary cycle lengths or individual-edge price asymmetries.
A specialist windmill resistance-index paper was accessible at abstract level only; independent mathematical validation is not performed.
title: Exact heterogeneous conductance allocation for bouquets of four-cycles
